name: Electromagnetic Field
description: Universal signal carrier enabling resonance and coupling across scales. Mediates light, radio, and bioelectric communication. Governed by Maxwell's equations with tau (2pi) as the fundamental oscillation constant.

core_attributes.pattern: signal carrier, resonance coupling across scales

scope.definition: Constancy of electromagnetic wave propagation speed across all inertial reference frames — measured relative precision of c = 299,792,458 m/s from NIST/BIPM laser measurement.

evidence.source: Evenson et al. (1972) 'Speed of light from direct frequency and wavelength measurements', Physical Review Letters 29:1346; BIPM (2019) SI redefinition documents.
cross_domain_examples: c measured to 1 part in 10¹¹ by frequency-comb techniques — the most precisely measured physical constant
c now defines the meter (since 1983) — its constancy is exact by SI definition
GPS system depends on c constancy to ±30 cm precision over 20,000 km signal paths
special relativity: Michelson-Morley experiment confirmed c independence of observer motion to 10⁻⁸

scope.falsifiability: If interferometric measurements detect c variation with observer velocity greater than 10⁻⁷, special relativity's second postulate fails.
scope.measurement_limits: c is now defined exactly; uncertainty lies in measurement of length and time standards. Cosmological c constancy over cosmic time is tested to 10⁻⁵ via quasar spectra.
